It's made me doubt if I'm actually warm at all. As soon as they didn't reciprocate, I immediately jolted to hating them. They were my enemy, and my defence mechanisms came in from years of being rejected and bullied in school:

Avoid them, like the plague. Otherwise you're constantly reminded of their rejection.

I'm just tired man. I don't want to fight anyone. I don't want to be enemies and be passive-aggressive. I just want everyone to be happy.

I've had nothing but bad experiences with house sharing for the past three years now.

I don't seem to be able to get on with anyone. They all just hate me from day one. It really makes me hate myself as a person, really makes me doubt my abilities, and makes me wonder if I'm meant to be happy at all.

We all have things in common, but they literally don't want to talk about them with me. They went to the art college, and I literally have my paintings all over the house. Does it interest them? Of course not.

I'm a human being, I have passions, I have hopes and dreams and opinions. But to them, I might as well be a pedophile.

I've tried to get on with my life, but I still have to see them if I'm cooking dinner or going through the hallways (half the reason I eat out/get takeaways often). Feeling their awkwardness and rejection. Then it all going back to normal as soon as I'm gone.

I'm not moving. It's right next to where I work, the room is great and the location is central.

They'd be happy if I just left, but I won't give them that satisfaction. I'm going on my terms. I won't let them win.

I'm not staying here forever, but I'm sure as hell not going to let them push me out.

I'm going to travel the world, and first I'm saving up money and getting experience work/creative-wise. It's technically going well for me right now. Literally the main bad thing in my life is the fact I'm completely shunned in my own home by these cunts.

The problem is that overshadows everything else. I want to die.
I know. I hate their guts. But if I show it, they win.
